title: BEN (Better Enchantment Numbers)
description: Changes the roman numerals to numbers from 1 up to 255
body:
## **Main Information**
This resource pack changes the enchantment levels like shown from the examples below

it works for every enchantment because the levels are seperate from the enchantments themselves.

### Basic Examples

- Sharpness V into Sharpness 5
- Protection IV into Protection 4
- Power II into Power 2

### More important Examples

- Sharpness enchantment.level.100 into Sharpness 100
- Smite enchantment.level.255 into Smite 255
- Multishot enchantment.level.2 into Multishot 2 (fun fact: shoots 5 arrows)

## **Alternate Ways to Download BEN (Better Enchantment Numbers)**
